description: University-account Copilot with stated privacy and model-training protections for students.
howToObtain: Use Edge while signed in with a University account, or sign in at copilot.microsoft.com with University email and password.

evidence.evidenceSnippet: The University of Birmingham says Microsoft Copilot is available free to all University of Birmingham students. Students sign in with their University account or University email and password; the page says queries and chats are not stored or used to train the underlying model.
